notes.title: A Message to Our Diary Readers
notes.content: [p][b]Dear All Diary Readers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]The Diary[/i] officially launched on June 20, and it's now been a week since release. We'd like to take a moment to connect with you and share some thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]Since launch, we’ve been carefully reading through your feedback—whether it’s encouragement, criticism, or thoughtful suggestions. Some diary readers have expressed concerns such as:[/p][list][*][p][i]"There’s just not enough content to justify the price."[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]"I’m not sure what the story is really about—it feels too vague."[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]"It looks nice, but I finished it too quickly and was left a bit disappointed."[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These are just a few examples, but they echo three common themes: [b]limited content[/b], [b]unclear storytelling[/b], and [b]pricing concerns[/b]. We’d like to address these topics directly and offer some insight into the intentions behind the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]1. About the Game’s Direction and Intent[/b][/p][p]From the very beginning, our vision for [i]The Diary[/i] was to create something closer to an interactive story—an experience similar in spirit to [i]Florence[/i]. Rather than focusing on complex puzzles or gameplay mechanics, we aimed to tell a gentle, emotionally resonant narrative that unfolds through mood, pacing, and small moments.[/p][p]We understand that some diary readers may have expected more gameplay depth or a more traditional story arc. If the experience didn’t align with those expectations, we truly understand—and we take responsibility for not communicating our creative direction more clearly before release. We hope this message helps provide some clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2. About the “Confusing Story”[/b][/p][p]When crafting the script, we debated whether to reveal the plot or leave intentional gaps fully. Ultimately, we chose the latter, deliberately omitting direct references to the key “plan” in the narrative. We aimed to provide space for interpretation, allowing players to uncover the story’s mysteries through reflection. However, we recognize that we may not have struck the right balance between revelation and ambiguity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]3. About “Limited Content”[/b][/p][p]We’ve received suggestions to include more diary entries to flesh out the story’s twists and developments. This ties into our earlier point about intentionally keeping certain elements understated. However, we understand this approach may have clashed with some expectations. We’re currently discussing whether additional content could help address these narrative gaps, though this will take time to evaluate.[/p][p][/p][p]Every piece of feedback—positive or critical—has been taken to heart. Since the project began two years ago, [i]The Diary[/i] has faced many challenges, and it was only recently completed. We acknowledge that we haven’t fully met everyone’s expectations. Moving forward, we will consider all your suggestions and feedback to explore ways to enhance and refine the game experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support and constructive criticism.[/p][p][/p][p][b]With heartfelt thanks,[/b][/p][p][i][b]The Diary[/b][/i][b] Development Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 《她的日记》最新进度公布！
notes.content:
各位玩家们你们好！

《她的日记》开发团队所有成员提前祝大家新年快乐！距离上一次公布最新进度，已经过了很长时间。这段时间里，我们依然在努力开发游戏中，这次我们带来了一些阶段性的结果。

我们为第一本日记进行了大范围的美术+动画效果的调优，视觉效果与以前相比有了更丰富的动画细节。同时我们也优化了第一本日记中手账手写字体、拼贴字的呈现逻辑，大家阅读起来会更加顺畅，小游戏的操作交互也做了优化调整。

目前我们已经将此版本更新到Demo上，大家可以下载体验~

[b]最新开发情况[/b]

我们深知《她的日记》已经让大家等待了许久，但请相信我们依然在尽全力前行。目前《她的日记》正处于全速开发状态，第二本书和第三本采用了全新的视觉和玩法，预计在三月内开发完成。第四本内容也会在二月份同步开始制作，届时会在各个平台上发布预告，或是和大家分享我们的开发情况！

第二本内容经过了几次大规模调整，目前采取了全新的视觉风格和玩法。春节后，我们将在《她的日记》游戏本体上更新第二本的部分内容，此前参与众筹的玩家已经激活了游戏本体，可以前往steam体验全新的内容，并就新的视觉和玩法给我们提供意见或建议。

notes.title: The Diary Latest Update
notes.content:
Hi, The Diary fans!
First of all, sorry for taking such a long time to give a formal response to your queries. The development of the game hit some snags which resulted in delays. Here's an update on where we are at in producing The Diary.

[h3]Changes in the Team[/h3]
Many unexpected things happened, but what affected the production speed the most was the departure of a team member due to family, financial, and personal problems.

The new programmer and artist I recruited needed time to get accustomed to the project. It also meant that the game development took much longer than anticipated. The good news is that our team has stabilized now, and we've gone from a 2-person team to a 3-person team that is determined to finish the job and do it right.

[h3]Status of the Project[/h3]
We've actually completed the development of the first version of the second and third diary books at the start of the year, though the overall quality was lacking compared to the first book. We've chosen to redo the levels in the second and third books and try out a new art style to get them closer to our ideal version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44109841/1a14ae66b821daf29c3adbd6fce06ef5c84e27a0.png[/img]
Screenshot of first version in development (abandoned)

This new art style introduction gave us new inspiration, but it also coincided with the changes happening on our team. It took us a longer time to get there, but the overall feel of the art is going in a direction that we're satisfied with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44109841/a009a3b1ce2ffaeea9e0682f921f202eb3e06a3f.png[/img]
Screenshot of second version in development (abandoned)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44109841/a6584833031be7926de11d5c73224ef084fb6a54.png[/img]
Screenshot of third version in development

The art style of the second and third diary books is now very close to the final version. We've restarted game development about a month ago, and we are making steady progress.

[h3]Our Plans[/h3]
We'd planned on releasing a free prologue, but it was put on hold because we were not satisfied with that version. There are now changes on Steam that discourage devs from releasing separate prologues and encourage us to use demos instead. 
We hope that you, our players, will bear with us as we sort this out.
We plan on updating our game demo and opening up a play-testing phase to give you a taste of our new content.
We will definitely finish making Her Diary, no matter what. We want to make sure the quality of the game meets expectations and would like to present it to our players within this year.
Thank you all once again for your continued support. The most difficult time for our game development has passed, so please be patient for a little while longer.

notes.title: The Diary plans to release a free prologue!
notes.content:
Dear gamer friends, it's been a while!

We bring you some exciting news: [b]The Diary plans to release a free prologue very soon![/b] 

The prologue will contain the complete content of the first book and the first 30% of the second Diary, primarily focusing on the events surrounding Ash's disappearance, the mysteries surrounding it, and the roles other characters played in her disappearance.

Over the past period, we've been refining the gameplay and art style of the second and third diaries. After several optimizations from the initial version, we conducted a small-scale, undisclosed testing phase. However, based on the feedback received, there's still room for improvement in both art style and gameplay. Therefore, we've decided to scrap the previous versions and start afresh, which took us some time. Eventually, we settled on an art style for the second book that we believe better matches the game's style and began refining the gameplay.

[b]For art style demonstration purposes only, not final presentation[/b]

We plan to release the free prologue in May. What stories and twists will the second book bring? Stay tuned to find out!
